subject: Post-demo procurement follow-up: paperwork and preferred payment path
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Kelly Ruiz <procurement@acmehealth.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 07 Jun 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo procurement follow-up: paperwork and preferred payment path

Hi Kelly — thanks again for carving out time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so your AP/procurement team has everything in one place:

Recap from our call
- Acme Health is evaluating Redwood for anonymized customer support embeddings and dedicated inference for peak nightly traffic.
- Primary procurement questions: preferred payment path (PO/net terms vs. card vs. cloud marketplace), vendor onboarding packet, and tax paperwork (W-9 vs W-8).

What we need from you (from AP)
1) Confirm preferred payment path: we support
   - PO + Net 30 (invoice)
   - Corporate card (we accept payment via our billing portal; card on file or marketplace purchasing)
   - Cloud marketplace (AWS Marketplace listing available; procurement gets a consolidated bill)
Please indicate which option your team prefers and any constraints (e.g., PO template required).

2) Vendor packet details: attached is our vendor packet and onboarding checklist. If you prefer, we can send a DocuSign version. Please confirm who on your side signs vendor agreements and where to upload bank details.

3) Tax forms: we included a blank W-9 for US entities. If Acme is non-US for any entity, we can accept W-8 BEN-E.

Mutual action plan (proposed)
- By Tue (2026-06-09): Acme confirms payment path and returns completed vendor packet + W-9/W-8.
- By Fri (2026-06-12): Redwood to provide final contract/PO template if needed and PRF for finance.

Attachments:
- redwood_vendor_packet.pdf (vendor packet, requires signature)
- ops_onboarding_checklist.xlsx (ops checklist for onboarding)
- W-9_General_Template.pdf (tax form example)

If it helps, Ben (cc'd) can jump into a short call with AP to walk through the packet.

Thanks — talk soon.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Senior Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123
[Attachment: redwood_vendor_packet.pdf (pdf), ops_onboarding_checklist.xlsx (xlsx), W-9_General_Template.pdf (pdf)]

From: Kelly Ruiz <procurement@acmehealth.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@acmehealth.com>
Date: Mon, 08 Jun 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo procurement follow-up: paperwork and preferred payment path

Hi Hannah — thanks for the clear summary and materials. A few quick notes from AP after our internal sync:

1) Preferred payment path: Acme's default is PO with Net 30. Card payments are only used for ad-hoc SaaS purchases under $5k and require a procurement exception. Would you be able to support PO + Net 30? If so, we will route a PO once the vendor packet and tax form are in our system.

2) Marketplace: If Redwood is on AWS Marketplace (or Azure), we prefer to buy there when possible because it simplifies chargeback, but it's not a hard requirement. Can you confirm whether the pricing is the same on Marketplace vs direct?

3) Vendor packet upload: We use Coupa for vendor onboarding. We will upload the signed packet and W-9 to Coupa. Is there any bank routing info required to be included in the initial packet, or will Acme request banking details only after PO issuance?

4) Contract signature: Who at Redwood signs the standard SOW/master agreement? Is DocuSign supported?

Timing: AP can process the vendor packet in ~3 business days after we receive the packet + completed W-9. Our tentative target: PO by end of week (2026-06-12) if everything is in order.

I've attached our standard vendor onboarding form (Acme_vendor_onboarding_form.pdf) that includes our Coupa vendor ID fields.

Thanks,
Kelly Ruiz
Senior Procurement Manager | Acme Health
procurement@acmehealth.com
[Attachment: Acme_vendor_onboarding_form.pdf (pdf)]

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Kelly Ruiz <procurement@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 09 Jun 2026 11:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo procurement follow-up: paperwork and preferred payment path

Hi Kelly — quick answers from our finance/ops side below (cc Hannah and Aditya):

- PO + Net 30: Yes, we support PO with Net 30. Please include any PO-specific language in your PO and send the PO to invoices@redwood.ai. We will reconcile against the signed vendor packet.

- Card vs Marketplace pricing: Pricing is consistent across channels for the initial term; discounts/promotions can vary. For AWS Marketplace purchases there is an extra 12% fee on our side that we typically absorb for enterprise deals depending on contract structure. If you want a Marketplace quote, I can pull exact SKU pricing.

- Bank details: We do not require bank routing info in the initial packet. After the vendor record is created in Coupa, our finance team will request banking details securely (or you can provide an ACH form via DocuSign).

- Signature and DocuSign: We use DocuSign for most vendor agreements and SOWs. The vendor packet can be returned signed or via DocuSign — whichever is easier for Acme.

Next steps we suggest:
1) Kelly: upload the signed vendor packet + W-9 to Coupa and share the Coupa vendor ID (or send the completed packet directly to invoices@redwood.ai).
2) Hannah/Aditya: we'll generate a short PO-friendly PRF and sample invoice flow for your AP to review by EOD Wed (2026-06-10).

If you'd like, we can set a 20-minute handoff call between your AP team and our finance ops to walk the process.

Best,
Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0188

Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 10:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo procurement follow-up: paperwork and preferred payment path

Thanks Ben — that all helps. I'm routing to AP now with your instructions (invoices@redwood.ai) and will upload the signed packet + W-9 to Coupa today. I expect to have a PO number for you by end of day Friday (2026-06-12).

One small follow-up: Acme requires a tax classification field on the vendor record (our Coupa form asks for the supplier "Tax ID type" and "Tax ID number"). Is Redwood able to provide the EIN and the tax classification string for the vendor record? If you can send that to invoices@redwood.ai or reply here, I'll forward to AP.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — I'll confirm once the packet is in Coupa.

Best,
Kelly Ruiz
Senior Procurement Manager | Acme Health
procurement@acmehealth.com
